questions.markdown:
Determine the phenomenon of "race-around" that can occur in a simple edge-triggered JK Flip-Flop. Explain how the architecture of a Master/Slave Flip-Flop prevents this problem by effectively isolating the input from the output during the critical clock transition.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

Examine the JK flip-flop with a logic diagram, truth table, a characteristic equation and an excitation table.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

Since a computer has many registers, paths must be provided to transfer information from one register to another. An efficient scheme for transferring the information between registers in a multiple-register configuration is a common bus system. Design a 4-bit common bus system for 4-registers of 4-bits each using multiplexers.

Determine the key structural difference between a Synchronous Counter and an Asynchronous Counter. Justify why the synchronous approach, where all flip-flops are clocked simultaneously, is essential for high-speed operation in digital systems.
